date_shape_parity: rejected ISO strings and explicit null next_due; accepted legacy null expiry and missing next_due
healthy_long_cycle: renewed past original deadline; rival denied
new_clock_skew: first acquisition uses server time; fast client denied
crash_recovery: SIGKILL, denied before expiry; newly spawned slow-clock process acquired after expiry and completed
stale_renewal_and_release: expired owner denied; successor document preserved
actual_long_process_completion: original owner recorded own result after original TTL
